description: Two environment flags, DEBUG and TRACE_ENV, each read as a boolean and used to gate a different piece of debug output.

steps.description: Both flags are read the same way. `DEBUG` and `TRACE_ENV` each come from `os.environ.get` with a default of `"0"`, compared to `"1"` for a boolean. The page shows one command that sets both for a single run: `DEBUG=1 TRACE_ENV=1 python3 mylang.py tests/closures.ml`.
`lookup` checks `TRACE_ENV` and, when it is on, prints the name being looked up and the keys in the environment to stderr. The comment marks the rest of `lookup`.

title: Combining Multiple Flags
